entities.summary: Poland is a sovereign nation in Eastern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Warsaw. Official languages include Polish. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 37.7 million. Area: 312,696 km². Comprehensive index for Poland covering Piast dynasty (966 baptism of Mieszko I, Christianisation), Jagiellonian dynasty/Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (1385-1795, largest European state 16th century), Partitions (1772-1918, erased from map 123 years by Russia/Prussia/Austria), WWI, Second Polish Republic (1918-39), WWII (1939-45, 6M dead including 3M Jews, Warsaw Uprising 1944, Holocaust), communist People's Republic (1945-89), Solidarity (1980, Walesa, first independent trade union in Soviet bloc), Round Table Talks 1989, Third Republic, EU 2004.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Poland's complex history, including its Christianization in 966 and its role as a major European state from the Jagiellonian dynasty to the Partitions, had significant regional impact. Its experience during WWII resulted in the loss of 6 million lives, including 3 million Jews.
